data.title: Mirelight Survivors ECS ceiling cart
data.description: Review playable 800-1000-live-entity survivors reference cart, deterministic hooks/watches/playtests, spatial collision design, native acceptance, and opt-in release allocation benchmark.

data.body: LOW: In normal mode, a single award_xp() large enough to cross multiple level thresholds runs this while loop N times but only ever sets phase='levelup' once, so the player gets one choose_upgrade() selection while N levels are consumed — the extra upgrade picks are silently dropped. Not reachable from ordinary 2-XP dew pickups (next_xp starts at 18), but the documented grant_xp dev hook can pass an arbitrary amount (the playtest grants exactly 18 = one level, so it doesn't exercise this). Stress mode is unaffected since it auto-applies an upgrade per iteration. Consider queuing pending level-ups or clamping XP carryover if multi-level via the hook should behave predictably.

data.reason: Reviewed all changed source (game.lua, spatial.lua, main.lua, render.lua, Rust acceptance/benchmark test) and cart data. 4 non-ignored tests pass, clippy clean. Spatial broad-phase, deferred structural edits, bounded watches, and the counting-allocator benchmark are sound; dense trace is verified deterministic. One LOW note on award_xp multi-level upgrade drop (dev-hook path only).

data.body: Fixed in the workspace: normal mode now increments pending_upgrades for every crossed threshold, choose_upgrade consumes one pending choice at a time, and status exposes the bounded count. Added large_xp_grants_queue_every_normal_upgrade_choice proving a 100-XP dev-hook grant queues and consumes all three choices before returning to play. Focused suite now passes 5 tests (1 benchmark ignored).

data.reason: Queued-upgrade fix and focused regression added in 2f1dd54

Fixes verified: normal-mode multi-level XP now increments pending_upgrades per crossed threshold; choose_upgrade consumes one at a time and holds in levelup while pending>0; status exposes the bounded count. New test large_xp_grants_queue_every_normal_upgrade_choice proves a 100-XP dev-hook grant queues 3 upgrades and drains 3->2->1->0 before returning to play. 5 tests pass (1 benchmark ignored), clippy clean.
